custody_requirements: Independent source/population custodian binds the label-blind family.
Independent outcome custodian executes the one frozen run.
Content-addressed result verifier receives outputs without candidate authorship.

frozen_first_route.no_substitution: If the complete pinned family cannot supply seven new exact-rights keyword-capable reviews, stop this route; do not add post-census sources.

matched_arms: EXACT_U4_PLUS_PROVIDER_KEYWORDS with only the frozen typed field added

minimum_support.why_seven: Seven of seven avoids a structural sign ceiling and preserves the unchanged 6/7 sign gates without threshold relaxation.

prospective_selection_rule: Enumerate the complete pinned index without label values or model outcomes.
Exclude every SWIFT, SYNERGY V5, KIFMS V7 and V9/V10 review identity and every frozen prior content identity.
Require title, abstract, provider-native keywords and binary label schema plus exact CC-BY-4.0 or CC0 rights.
Require nonempty provider-native keywords in the frozen predeclared completeness fraction; never impute keywords from title/abstract.
Select the seven smallest eligible label-blind raw row counts, breaking ties by review identity; retain all seven.
Freeze exact source bytes, canonical population, content disjointness, keyword coverage, u4 and keyword-only representation before labels/outcomes.
reason: V13 binds one real provider-native keyword state outside exact u4, but the current V10 population exposes keywords in only 4/7 reviews, making the unchanged 6/7 sign gates structurally unreachable under exact-u4 fallback.

unchanged_contract.fallback: Exact u4 on any binding or signal failure
